reviews.name: 임****
reviews.content:
8개월된  푸들 3.5키로  M 사이즈   
여유가 좀 있고  길이 적당하고  아웃도어 점퍼라   신축성 좋고  지퍼가  등옆에  있어    입고 벗는것이  너무  편하게 되어있고  모자도  아이머리에 맞게 조절할수 있어  정말   만족도 200% 입니다    맞춤옷 같이  너무  너무 이쁘게  잘 맞아요 
원단이  너무   얇아서  진짜  방수가  잘되는지도   확인도 했는데   DWR발수 가공이라서  정말    방수가  잘되네요  
 아직  옷에대한  거부감이  많은 아이라  옷을 입혀놓음  얼음땡  놀이하듯  싫어하는데  이옷은 콧김으로도  날아갈것 같은  가벼운  무게라  거부감 들지않고  맘에 드는 모양입니다  지퍼쪽엔  반사야광 으로  되어있어  밤에도  괜찬을듯 합니다  원단이  너무좋아  저도  입고 싶은 충동이 마구마구   생기네요 ㅎㅎ 
집이  시골이라  아직은   아침ㆍ저녁엔  춥고  낮은 덥고 ㅎ 때론   바람이  많이 불어  산책시 아이 옷을 입히기가  참 애애했는데  레터 필름커버 자켓으로  조금  쌀랑할땐   바람막이로  입히고  비올땐  레인점퍼로  입히고  여러모로    활용도가  아주 높은옷인듯   하네요   
레타 필름커버 자켓 덕분에  환절기   옷걱정은  이제는  
 노~~노   앞으로  산책이  즐거울듯 합니다 
  감사합니다  잘입히겠습니다 

지금까지  레터  필름커버 자켓   체험단으로 선정된   상품에 대한   솔직한 후기를   작성하였습니다
reviews.content_en:
8-month-old Poodle, 3.5kg, M size
There's a bit of room, the length is just right, and as an outdoor jacket, the elasticity is great. The zipper is on the side, making it super easy to put on and take off. The hood can also be adjusted to fit my pup's head perfectly, so I'm 200% satisfied! 😍 It fits so beautifully, just like custom-made clothing.
The fabric is so thin that I even checked if the waterproofing actually works, and with the DWR water-repellent coating, it really does repel water well!
My pup still resists wearing clothes and acts like she's playing freeze tag when dressed up, but this jacket is so light it feels like it could blow away with just a breath, so she doesn't resist it and actually seems to like the look of it. The zipper has reflective glow, so it should be fine even at night too. The fabric is so good that I keep getting the urge to get one for myself too 😄
Since we live in the countryside, it's still cold in the morning and evening, hot during the day, and sometimes very windy 😅 Getting my pup dressed for walks has been such a hassle, but with this letter film cover jacket, I can throw it on as a windbreaker when it's a bit chilly, and use it as a rain jacket when it rains. It's such a versatile piece in so many ways.
Thanks to the letter film cover jacket, I don't have to worry about clothes during the transition season anymore!
No more worries~ I'm looking forward to enjoying our walks from now on.
Thank you so much! We'll wear it well.

I've written this honest review as a selected tester for the letter film cover jacket.

*[Note: This was written as a product tester review]*

reviews.name: 손****
reviews.content:
(강아지 옷착용사이즈: 작게나온옷은 라지! 크게나온옷은 미디움!)
사이즈표를 보니 살짝 애매한거 같더라구요.. 고민하다가

생각보다 더 작았지만?! ㅎㅎ 다행히 잘 맞더라구요! 어차피 털찔때 입을 옷이 아니라 다행인거 같아요~^^ 지퍼가 너무 편해서 자주 입힐 거 같고! 기능성이어서 심신안정이 됩니다~ㅎㅎ 무척 얇아서 정말 비오거나 햇빛쨍쨍일때 풀밭에 가게될지모르니 언제든 입혀도 괜찮을 거 같더라구요~^^
reviews.content_en:
(Dog clothing size worn: Small-fitting clothes = Large! Large-fitting clothes = Medium!)
The size chart seemed a bit ambiguous, so I was worried... but I thought bigger would be worse, so I ordered it!
It turned out smaller than expected! 😄 But thankfully it fit well! Since it's not a jacket to wear during shedding season anyway, that's actually a relief~^^ The zipper is so convenient that I think I'll put it on often! The functionality gives me peace of mind~😊 It's so thin that even if we end up in a grassy area on a rainy or super sunny day, it should be fine to wear anytime~^^

reviews.name: 박****
reviews.content:
#체험단
예랑이랑 요즘 산책할 때 꼭 챙겨입는 바잇미 LATTA 윈드브레이커 💛
가볍게 툭 걸쳐주기만 했는데 핏이 너무 귀엽고 활동성도 좋아서 예랑이가 불편해하지 않더라구요! 특히 립스탑 나일론 소재라 스크래치에 강하고, 생활방수 느낌의 DWR 발수 기능까지 있어서 바람 부는 날이나 가벼운 비 오는 날에도 안심 🤭
안감도 털 끼임이 적어서 입고 벗길 때 편했고, 산책 후 털이나 먼지가 덜 묻는 느낌이라 관리도 쉬웠어요. 무엇보다 커플룩 느낌으로 같이 입을 수 있어서 사진 찍을 때마다 시선강탈✨
예랑이도 신나게 뛰어다니는 거 보니까 착용감이 정말 편한가봐요 🐶🍃
reviews.content_en:
#TestReview
Yerang and I always bring our BITE ME LATTA windbreaker whenever we go for walks these days 💛
I just threw it on lightly, but the fit is so cute and the mobility is great, so Yerang doesn't find it uncomfortable at all! The ripstop nylon fabric is especially resistant to scratches, and with DWR water-repellent functionality that gives a lifestyle waterproofing feel, I feel safe on windy days or when there's light rain 🤭
The lining also doesn't catch fur much, so it was convenient putting it on and taking it off. After walks, there's noticeably less fur and dust sticking to it, so maintenance is easy too. Best of all, we can wear matching couple looks, so we steal the show every time we take photos ✨
Seeing Yerang excitedly running around must mean the fit is really comfortable 🐶🍃

reviews.name: 남****
reviews.content:
#체험단 후추가 입어봤어요!
가볍고 착용감이 정말 좋아서 데일리로 자주 손이 가는 아이템이에요. 얇은 소재지만 바람을 잘 막아줘서 간절기 아우터로 활용하기 좋고, 생활방수 기능도 있어 갑작스러운 비에도 부담 없이 입을 수 있어요. 디자인도 깔끔하고 핏이 예뻐서 다양한 코디에 잘 어울리는 점도 마음에 들어요. 얇아서 한여름만 아니면 계속 입게 될 것 같아요!
reviews.content_en:
#TestReview Gochu tried it out!
It's so lightweight and comfortable to wear that it's an item I reach for often as a daily essential. Even though it's a thin fabric, it blocks wind well, making it great to use as an outer layer during transition seasons. With the lifestyle waterproofing function, I can wear it without worry even during sudden rain. I also love how the design is clean and the fit is pretty, so it goes well with various outfits. Since it's thin, I think I'll keep wearing it except during the peak of summer!

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
요즘 산책할 때 입히고 다니는데 진짜 만족해요.

reviews.content_en:
I wear it on walks these days and I'm really satisfied with it.
First of all, it's incredibly light and soft, so there's no discomfort at all during activity.

It's also easy to put on and take off, so I can quickly dress my pup without stress before heading out for a walk. That's another great advantage.

And when folded, it takes up almost no space, so it fits right into my bag for easy portability.

It blocks wind well too, so it seems perfect for windy days or transition seasons 🩵

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content: 더위를 많이 타는 포메라(늘 털옷경량패딩 입고있는)패딩보다는 바람막이로 사보자! 생각하던때 발견한 요 옷! 너무 이뻐요~~ 입혀보니 털때문에 속이 빵실 채워지며 자동 패딩완성! 늦가을부터 초봄까지 잘쓸거같아요. 패키지도 지퍼백으로 깔끔하고(강아지 배변 롤백 담아두려고요)세탁도 간단하고 빨리 말라요. 컬러도 너무 예쁨!
reviews.content_en: My Pomeranian runs hot (I usually have her in lightweight padding), so when I thought about trying a windbreaker instead, I found this jacket! It's so pretty~~ When I put it on her, her fur fills out the inside perfectly creating an automatic padding effect! I think we'll use it well from late fall to early spring. The packaging is also neat with a zipper bag (I'm planning to keep poop bags in it), laundry is simple and dries quickly. The colors are so pretty too!

reviews.name: 네****
reviews.content:
색감 예쁘고 지퍼 이게 채울 필요없어서 진짜 편해요 근데 원래 가슴둘레보다 10센치 좀 안되게 여유있는 사이즈(보통 입던사이즈) 했더니 너무 딱맞아서 한치수 더 크게 교환했어요 
다리 밑단이나 엉덩이쪽 다 단순 고무줄마감이라 통대창 몸매에는 좀 딱맞는거 같더라규용
개선한다면 길이조절 스트링이나 사람 바막처럼 여유있는 밴드처리도 괜찮을거같아요
아 그리고 빨리 걸으면 사부작사뷰작 소리납니당ㅋㅋㅋ
reviews.content_en:
The colors are pretty and since the zipper doesn't need to be fastened, it's really convenient. But I usually get a size with about 10cm extra room around the chest, and it ended up fitting perfectly snugly, so I exchanged it for a size up.
The leg cuffs and rear end are just finished with simple elastic, so it might fit a bit snugly on a slim figure 😅
If they could improve it, maybe add a length-adjustable drawstring or loose band finishing like human windbreakers.
Oh, and it makes a rustling sound when walking quickly 😄
